book.name: Korɛ̃ntitaamba sɛbɛhãalĩŋo
book.title: Polŋ nyɛgãaŋ sɛbɛhãalĩŋo maŋ hã Korɛ̃ntitaamba‑i

content: Na saa da, hĩɛma-na bande‑i-na, i kũɔma dii ŋaa gbuganni, ma sa cɔ. Ŋga i suyaa wuɔ diɛ ku, Diiloŋo ka hã-ye kũɔfɛlɛmma dɔrɔ‑i-na. Kũɔfɛlɛmma famma ka waa ŋaa kɔlluŋ-dũnni a ce i siɛ tiraa gbãa ku.
Iŋ yeŋ terieŋgu maŋ nuɔ‑i fiɛfiɛ‑i-na, i gbu i niya kũɔma famma damma‑i a ce i tiɛ waana.
Ŋga i suyaa wuɔ diɛ hel gbugaŋ daani-na, i siɛ tĩɛ bebelle.
I sa taara i ku aa suɔ da kũɔŋ daama‑i, i taara i da-ma cicɛ̃lma ku'i ciɛ i tiɛ niya aa tiɛ waana.
Diilo fuɔ fɛrɛ yaa tigiiŋ i cicuɔŋgu‑i dumaaŋo-na tuɔ cie-ye, aa hã-ye u *Yalle‑i i diɛ suɔ wuɔ uŋ tigiiŋ kumaŋ hiere i ka da-ku.
A ce dumaaŋo-na sirɛiŋa da-ye yinni maŋ joŋ, aa i suyaa wuɔ diɛ waa baa i kũɔŋ daama‑i, i maa baa Itieŋo nelle‑i.
Kumaŋ ciɛ mi waŋ-ma dumaaŋo-na, i ne iŋ haa i naŋga‑i kumaŋ nuɔ‑i aa tiɛ wuɔ, i sa ne iŋ daŋ kumaŋ baa i yufieŋa.
Sirɛiŋa dii-yiɛ ninsoŋo, ŋga i taara i yaŋ i kũɔŋ daama‑i aa kã ka waa Itieŋo caaŋ-nu.
Ŋga kumaŋ yuŋgu, i taara i fɛ̃ Itieŋo huɔŋga‑i. Ii dii baa i kũɔŋ daama‑i wa, ii si dii baa-ma wa, i taara i fɛ̃ u huɔŋga‑i.
Na saa da, i ka cor hiere *Kirsa wulaa u yuu-ye. Nɛliɛŋo nɛliɛŋo, uŋ ciɛ kumaŋ hĩɛma-na bande‑i-na, ku faa wa, ku balaaŋ wa, u ka da u maacemma sullu‑i.
Koŋkor-maacemma
Baŋ bĩŋ kumaŋ a kãŋ Itieŋo‑i i suɔ-ku, ku'i ciɛ i tiɛ gbãŋ baa nuɔmba da ba siɛ-ku. Diiloŋo suɔ i kusũnni‑i hiere fafamma. Aa namaa fɛrɛ‑i mi suyaa wuɔ na bi suɔ-ye fafamma.
I sa taara i tiraa kaal i fɛrɛ baa-na, ŋga i taara na hɔmmu fɛ̃ baa-ye. Ku yaa bamaŋ yaaŋ hɔmmu‑i aa ta ba ne bomborma, na ka ta na suɔ ba siɛma.
Aa miɛŋo‑i, diɛ pepiena kusuɔŋ-nu, i pepienaana Diiloŋ-maa-na; diɛ bi waa welewele kusuɔŋ-nu, i ciɛ welewele namaa maa-na.

Na saa da, *Kirsa nelnyulmu taa yaaŋga yiɛ i ãncemma-na hiere. Miɛ maŋ hũyãa-ma wuɔ nelduɔŋo diei'i kuu nuɔmba‑i hiere ba maama-na, miɛ maŋ hũyãa-ma wuɔ i kuu baa kutieŋo‑i, Kirsa nelnyulmu taa yaaŋga yiɛ i ãncemma-na hiere.
Kumaŋ ciɛ u ku nuɔmba‑i hiere ba maama-na, u taa u taara bamaŋ dii cicɛ̃lma‑i hiere, ba baa tiraa tĩɛ bafamba fɛrɛŋ maa-na, ba tĩɛ fuɔ maa-na. Fuɔ maŋ kuu ba sɔlaaŋgu‑i aa sire.
Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, i sa tiraa i ne moloŋo munyiɛrammu aa kãŋ-yo. Dĩɛlũɔ‑i-na, i taa i ne Kirsa‑i nelbilogbãŋgbãlãŋo, ŋga fiɛfiɛ‑i-na, i sa tiraa i ne-yo dumaa.
Da ŋ gbãŋ suur Kirsa horre-na, ŋ ciɛ nelfɛlɛŋ nuɔ: Ãncɔlɔmma curaa, ãnfɛlɛmma'i duɔŋ.
Kufaŋgu‑i daaku‑i hiere Diiloŋ-maacemma. U yaa ciɛ Kirsa dii-ye i-naa nuɔ baa-yo aa dii koŋkor-maacemma‑i i naŋ-na.
Na saa da, Diiloŋo puɔraa Kirsa ji dii nelbiliemba‑i ba-naa nuɔ baa-yo, u saa fer ba cãlmuɔ‑i. Aa u hãa miɛmɛi baa koŋkor-ãndaaŋgu‑i.
Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, i ciɛ Kirsa pɔpuɔrbieŋ miɛ. Kuu dii ŋaa Diiloŋo muo u natiɛŋa nɛi. Jande, niɛŋ Kirsa‑i aa na siɛ Diiloŋ-koŋkoro‑i na suur na-naa nuɔ baa-yo.
Kirsa saa naa ce halle ãmbabalma diei, ŋga Diiloŋo haa i ãmbabalma‑i hã u yaa‑i duɔ gbãa duɔ ce-ye nelviiŋ miɛ fuɔ barguɔ‑i-na.
